records.subject: Public Finance
records.groupTitle: Expenditure On Essential Services As A Percentage Of Total Government Expenditure
records.title: Expenditure On Essential Services As A Percentage Of Total Government Expenditure, Annual
records.dataSource: INTERNATIONAL MONETARY FUND, UNITED NATIONS GLOBAL SDG INDICATORS DATABASE
records.footnote: Data refer to the Government's financial year, which begins on 1 April of the current year and ends on 31 March of the following year.  Data follow the latest International Monetary Fund (IMF) Government Financial Statistics Manual (GFSM), GFSM 2014.  Data are used for SDG 1.a.2 'Proportion of total government spending on essential services (education, health and social protection)'.  Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 1.a.2.

row.footnote: Figures are based on general government expenditure on education from International Monetary Fund's World Economic Outlook Database.  Data prior to 2023 include Ministry of Education (MOE) and MOE Statutory Boards' expenditures, but excludes early childhood and pre-primary education expenditure under Early Childhood and Development Agency (ECDA).  Data from 2023 onwards, ECDA expenditure is included as part of education expenditure.

Figures are based on general government expenditure on health from International Monetary Fund's World Economic Outlook Database.  General government finance includes budgetary and extra-budgetary accounts.

Figures are based on general government expenditure on social protection from International Monetary Fund's World Economic Outlook Database.  General government finance includes budgetary and extra-budgetary accounts.
